source: Gleiber et al. 2024 Pelagic Species Trait Database v2
disposition: Research-only until per-field biological comparability and original citations are audited. None of these newly staged records are used in playable boards.
warnings: Converted total lengths use image ratios and taxonomic proxies; retain original measurement type instead.
Temperature fields can originate in FishBase estimate/TempPref rather than measured thermal tolerance.
Nutritional summaries combine ages and populations; use only explicit compatible stage, specimen part and measured units.
Photophore numeric entries need individual verification: larval averages and one unrelated Permian lungfish reference were found.
Database zeros and absence indicators are not numerical comparative measurements.
